meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会把设计对照 Dieter Rams 的十条“好设计”原则逐条打分(0~3分),给出证据和结论(新建/改进/重设计),最后生成一份可直接复制给 /make-plan 的提示词。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“检查这个 UI 是否符合 Rams 原则”等,或要求批评后给出计划时触发。常规代码审查、纯文案修改、尚无设计稿的构思不会触发。

say.text: 帮我按 Dieter Rams 十原则审计这个界面。
say.note: Claude 会开始逐条评分并产出报告。

say.text: 对这份设计做评审,给出重新设计的方案。
检查这个 UI 并告诉我哪里不诚实。
say.note: 聚焦第六原则“诚实”,指出夸大或误导之处。

howto.what_en: Claude will score the design against Dieter Rams' ten principles (0–3 each) with evidence, issue a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict, then write a copy-paste /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to audit a design, do a design review, check a UI against Rams, or requests a critique that leads to a plan. Not for routine code reviews, copy edits, or pre-design ideation.

say_en.text: Audit this interface against Dieter Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: Claude will score each principle and produce a report.

say_en.text: Review this design and propose a redesign.
say_en.note: Leads to a REDESIGN verdict and a /make-plan prompt.

say_en.text: Check this UI and tell me where it isn't honest.
say_en.note: Focuses on Principle #6 and flags overclaims or misleading bits.
